meta.title: Methanol synthesis flowsheet example (assisted first draft)
unknowns: The source describes an IDAES simulation notebook and states it does not represent any particular chemical process; plant applicability is unknown.

The order of the feed mixing, pre-reactor compressor and pre-reactor heater relative to each other is not given. The source states only that mixing and conditioning occur before the reactor, so no connections are drawn among the mixer, compressor, heater and reactor.

The positions of the turbine and the cooler relative to the reactor and the Flash unit are not stated as a process order. The degrees-of-freedom list on L60 is not stated to be in process order, so no connections are drawn for the turbine or cooler.
The direct connection between the reactor outlet and the Flash inlet is not given. The source calls the Flash post-reactor, but intermediate units may exist.

Recycle case: the source names no splitter or purge device. The source says most Flash vapor returns to the start of the process and gives the compressor feed as the tear stream. The exact recycle destination and split equipment are not represented.
The liquid Product block and the exhaust are simulation boundaries. Their physical equipment is unknown, so they are shown as battery limits.
No instrument, controller, final element, manual valve, relief device, interlock or trip tags are given.
Engineering units of plant lines, pipe sizes, operating conditions, valve fail positions and operating limits are unspecified. The 10-50% purge bound is an optimization bound, not an operating limit.
The heater and cooler utilities, and whether they are exchangers or other heat-transfer devices, are unspecified.
assumptions: Symbol dimensions and locations are proposed drafting geometry, not plant dimensions.
All unit and stream identifiers are newly assigned because the source supplies no tags.
The turbine has no supported symbol type. It is represented with the closest supported type, compressor, and keeps the name Turbine.
The stoichiometric feed mixing is represented as a feed_header mixer. The heater and cooler are represented as heat_exchanger. The Flash unit is represented as a separator.

Order-based interpretation for review: streams S-H2 and S-CO carry the hydrogen and carbon monoxide reactant vapors to the feed mixer, based on L10 (reactant vapors mixed prior to entering the reactor).
Order-based interpretation for review: stream S-LIQ runs from the Flash liquid outlet to the Product block battery limit, based on L58.
Order-based interpretation for review: stream S-VAP runs from the Flash vapor to the exhaust battery limit (purge), based on L73.
The model has seven units, so it is split over two sheets: pre-reactor units and reactor on D1, post-reactor units on D2.
